class: A required control that no rule covers, passed over in silence
symptom: Create Account was pressed with the required "I agree to creating this account to allow me to apply for positions with HonorHealth." box unticked; Workday answered "Please check the box to continue" and the run stopped on the form.
root_cause: The account form's consent rule (safety.is_privacy_consent) knew privacy notices only. This box is neither a privacy notice nor an attestation, so it matched no rule, was skipped with no log line, and the form was submitted regardless.
why_tests_missed: The create-account tests used privacy and terms wording; none used a consent to the account itself, and a skipped box left no trace to assert on.
fix: safety.is_account_creation_consent (owner-approved, 25 September 2026) accepts consent to creating the very account the owner asked for and refuses terms, declarations, signatures, marketing and data-sharing wording; _is_account_consent uses it. A box the agent must tick but cannot is left for the owner and Create is not pressed.
prevention: Every required control must end in one of three states: ticked by a named rule, left for the owner with a log line saying which, or blocking the submit. Never skip one silently, and never press the submit control while a required box is unticked.
